description: Get the exact ubriot CLI command that publishes an OTA (over-the-air) update for a React Native or Expo app. It does not publish anything itself: the JavaScript bundle must be exported on the machine that has the app's source, so run the returned command there.

channel.description: OTA channel (e.g. production, staging). Defaults to production.

description.description: What changed in this update (shown in logs)

name: ubriot_publish_ota
